jvm.scope: Spring/source lifecycle and action ordering; later native-window bounds and button sizing are covered by device checks, not an exact-head JVM rerun.

device.platform: Android 15 / API 35 emulator, host NVIDIA GPU; not a physical ARM64 phone
device.otherScope: The last change only made the existing full-window correction explicit for non-page hosts; full-page and standalone button branches are unchanged.

paper.note: Updates are graphicsLayer deformation updates, not presented frames or an FPS/GPU benchmark.

intermediateFindings: Initial cache fixture had no positive-size cache row; seeded a deterministic 4 KiB file and selected the detail window explicitly.
Robolectric direct callback driving left window disposal queued; the confirmation-slot case passes through the normal semantics click driver. Device duplicate-click handoff also passes.
Local semantics bounds passed while the footer was physically below the navigation-safe area. The new physical-coordinate assertion caught it.

The first bounds patch relied on initial LayoutParams.width, which was still WRAP_CONTENT in non-page windows. Replaced it with the explicit host fillWindow contract; the final three affected device cases pass.
limitations: No physical ARM64 device performance certification.
No unrelated full regression suite rerun.
The one-sample warp still costs more GPU work than a plain matrix transition.
